signal: A previous PAPER_RECEIPT_VERIFIED status.json survived an early --once startup guard failure, before the runner replaced status with RUNNING_NOT_VERIFIED.
root_cause: cloud_runner/main.py called validate_environment and runtime checkout/.env guards before invalidating the previous status.
upstream_downstream: Invalid/missing environment, wrong runtime branch or unreviewed .env could abort early while external status readers still observe previous success. CLI exception handler updates FAIL_CLOSED if invoked, but direct main() callers and abrupt termination before handler can leave stale success.
severity: P1 stale evidence false green, reproduced only with offline mocked startup; not a cloud incident claim
prevention_hypothesis: Write RUNNING_NOT_VERIFIED before any --once startup validation while keeping --preflight read-only.

baseline.checkout: exact event SHA matched (CI identity step success)
baseline.note: Synthetic old success status and mocked startup; no broker/cloud interaction

repair.scope: Invalidate prior status immediately after --once parse, before validation/branch/.env checks. Do not mutate status for --preflight.
repair.rollback: Governed revert on isolated branch only, preserve failing test; no force push.

regression.mode: offline unittest with temporary files, dummy flags and patched environment/branch checks

next_session_recurrence_check: Re-run test against exact deployed SHA and independently inspect failed startup status transitions in cloud evidence. Do not equate status flag with broker audit.
reopen_if: Any --once startup rejection retains a prior PAPER_RECEIPT_VERIFIED status
A failed cloud run is reported as current success
Status is trusted without matching run identity and source timestamps
